2026-10-13 01:08 PDT. Landed and deployed: PR #360 merged as 2141236e, released as v12.93.3, serving on the host since 00:50:04 (manager pid 61552, go build info vcs.revision 2141236e). All 21 PR checks and main CI passed, so the three build and CI criteria are met.

Still pending, with what exists:
- 6bee2cb (one advancing job for eight workers, by owner counters): the live host log shows one job per scope key (234 jobs over 80 scopes in 16 minutes, root sole at eight workers) and CI covers the join, but nothing was measured from owner counters.
- 7b1aa62 (bytes under the allowance, no foreground regression): foreground did not regress (outside root sole p50 514 -> 182 ms, p90 2424 -> 775 ms, p99 15018 -> 4808 ms). The allowance cannot be read live: owner stats do not separate warm reads from foreground reads and no surface reports the pacer. A status surface for warm bytes would close this.
- a3b408e (owner confirms the defaults): not asked yet. One more for that list: a scope that completes is re-walked from the start on the next demand, so one 1,456-member registered scope ran 182 unpaced zero-byte steps every 25 to 45 s.

Receipt on the host: /tmp/ram-pressure-refresh-20261012-2335/warm-delivery-result.json. Related: investigation b81ed03, task 0211d5f.
